title: Expert Network Industry Now Comprises ~80 Institutional Firms Across Multiple Tiers
summary: According to Silverlight Research's landscape taxonomy, the global expert network industry includes approximately 80 institutional firms, with 15 classified in the top 'Global Institutional Core' tier. Boutique and niche providers continue to grow as clients seek deeper domain expertise beyond generalist networks.
whyItMatters: The proliferation of niche expert networks signals market fragmentation and growing demand for specialized expertise.
